source_inference.finding: The HTML module entry used a browser-relative URL intended to cross Vite's filesystem root. The landed root-local TypeScript entry lets Vite's module resolver resolve the external fixture and emit an explicit filesystem URL.
reasoning: At original H, behavior.test.mjs:13-15 spawns Vite with cwd=desktop. desktop/vite.config.ts does not override root; Vite6.4.3 config.ts:1152-1154 defaults root to process.cwd().

desktop/forward-dialog-test.html:3 uses src=../frontend/src/production/ForwardMessageDialog.fixture.tsx. At /forward-dialog-test.html this browser URL denotes /frontend/src/production/ForwardMessageDialog.fixture.tsx, not the repository filesystem sibling outside desktop.

Vite6.4.3 indexHtml.ts:122-190,279-291 processes the script src as a URL and does not rewrite this external filesystem reference to /@fs/. resolve.ts:262-273 resolves a source URL against the configured root.
The existing config already permits repository filesystem access via server.fs.allow at line26; that permission does not map a browser /frontend URL to the sibling directory.
The repaired root-local entry imports ../frontend/... as a module. Vite6.4.3 importAnalysis.ts:103-129 rewrites resolved files outside the root to explicit /@fs/ URLs.

ForwardMessageDialog.tsx and vite.config.ts have identical blobs at original2a and successful59. The fixture.tsx itself also has the original blob at intermediate652. This isolates the original repair to fixture entry/loading and diagnostics rather than product component logic.
